formulae.basic_explanation: The gasket is the unique compact set left invariant by the union of three half-scale copies of itself, each placed at one corner of the equilateral triangle. Direct recursive subdivision of the triangle — removing each central sub-triangle at every generation — converges to the same attractor a chaos game would reach, but shows the self-similar hierarchy explicitly rather than as an emergent point cloud.

citation.chicago: Graduate Studies in Mathematics, Volume 247. An Invitation to Fractal Geometry: Fractal Dimensions, Self-Similarity, and Fractal Curves. Providence, RI: American Mathematical Society.
